title_zh: 球体物理测试场（地图 0）· 判据与运行计划
purpose: 纯自用的球体物理回归场：地形支撑 / 台阶 / 斜面 / 台面与边缘 / 吸附物凹凸 / 挡路 / 贴墙。不是玩家关卡，不进正式场景。
generated_by: hand-authored. Geometry is NOT in this file: each wired cell points at its own placement.json, which is the single source for what exists in the scene

geometry.why: one document per arena: a cell is exactly one arena, so the validator's hard budget applies per cell and the Unity importer binds one LevelArenaHost per document with no grouping logic to invent. The sandbox registers all of them together under the SANDBOX frame (registration_model).
fields_from_placement: structures[] (ground / boundary / box / ramp: the ONLY geometry)
level.arena.id (the managed-root child and the cell's identity)
level.budget (per-cell capacity, checked by levelbuild check)
structures[].role / structures[].kind (does this cell have a role=ramp, and which box is the kind=ramp_probe board the motor must refuse)
geometry.not_duplicated_here: registration boxes, ramp angles, boundary planes, ground, the ramp foot distance and the probe plane (all read from the scene colliders the importer built)
geometry.why_footprint_is_not_geometry: cells[].footprint is the RUNNER's activation rect and is now exactly the cell's pad (the ground plane has the same centre and size); the run-up is inside the pad. The test suite refuses geometry that leaves its own footprint.

scene.bounds_note: the cells sit on a compact grid (4 columns x 4 rows, 1-3 m between footprints; x -13.5..13.5, z -37.5..16). A cell placement has only its boards; the one big floor and the outer wall (x -16..16, z -42..19) are the SANDBOX placement.

motor_constants.fall_model: 支撑面消失后由 SupportSurfaceMath.ResolveFallState / TryIntegrateFall 做重力积分（半隐式欧拉，带 maxFallSpeedMps 护栏），不再用 maxDropPerStep 限制下落；maxDropPerStep 只用于地形过渡的下降钳位
motor_constants.source: Runtime/BallMotor/KatamariBallMotor.cs 的序列化字段与常量；ramps 为 TERRAIN_SUPPORT 的 P3 计划项，step 规则与 support_props（P1/P2）已实现
motor_constants.absorb_gate: Req_mm = floor(1000*cbrt(60*V/pi)), V = k*a*b*c (k default 0.70); absorbable iff floor(1000*D) >= Req_mm (PickupAbsorbMath). absorb_max_abc_m3 = the strict upper bound on a*b*c at k=0.70 for the preset's whole-mm diameter; the 0.30 preset is quantized to 0.2997 m (299 mm), where it is 0.002020 m3.

start.note: motor 默认 startCenterWorld = (0, 0.15, 0)，这里的 0.15 = 起始球半径

registration_model.why: motor 的静态 OBB 容量 256、平面 8。13 个已接线格的板合计 21 个 OBB，外加地面 + 4 张外围边界平面，一次放得下：所有格的板同时注册在一大块地面上，球自由滚。格的 placement 里只有测试板（level.arena.frame = shared，没有地面、没有围墙）。
registration_model.switch_rule: 唯一的注册：EnterSandbox。外框 SANDBOX.Register(true, 0, 0)（清表 + 地面 + 4 张外围平面），再逐格 Register(false, 已登记的盒数, 已登记的坡数)。脚本 run（BeginAll / BeginCell…）不改注册，只把球传到那一格的起点。
registration_model.per_cell_arena: a cell placement carries only its test boards (level.arena.frame = shared: no role=ground, no role=boundary; the validator and the importer both refuse them). The one floor and the 4 outer boundary planes are the SANDBOX document's.
registration_model.cost_note: 进沙盒一次 ClearObstacles + 登记（分配一对 Vector3[]，见 TERRAIN_SUPPORT §3.5 的 GC 风险）

sandbox.note: the frame arena of the manual sandbox: the one big floor (x -16..16, z -42..19, y=0) + 4 outer boundary planes, no boxes. Cells carry only their boards. Its geometry is that placement; this block carries only what the runner needs.
sandbox.spawn_note: in front of the south row, facing +Z (north): the four boards of the south row are 4.5-5.5 m ahead and the other rows line up beyond them. y is replaced by the ball's radius + 0.02 at run time.

v2 §7.7.4：nominal 仍是板顶 0.028（不是 D 的函数），但 lift 只在球 XZ 落在板的足印 ±1r 内累计（门由导入器烘的板足印 + 碰撞半径给，无魔法数）。门内四档应 ≤0.01（参考模型 −0.0002…0；pass8 的 rest_gap +0.0021 就是门内抬升）。全程最大值 +0.0189…+0.2133 出现在远端边界平面的合法爬升，是「全程最大值」这种判法的语义问题，不是电机缺陷

薄片不该把 4 个接触槽打满
球径误差 ≤ 1 mm（绝对值）：步骤 C+D 后成长量子是 1 mm³（约 7 nm 的直径当量），所以设定器能精确落在预设直径上，判据改为「实测直径与预设直径之差 ≤ 1 mm」。1 mm 与 float32 预算（直径 ~2e-8 相对）相比余量极大，只看设定器有没有收敛
单格盒 1 <= 8、斜面 0 <= 4，容量 latch 的基线差必须为 0；不为 0 说明这一格注册超了

checks.note: 50° 板交给 motor.AddRamp 必须被拒，且 GetLastRampRefusalReason() 非空（P3 护栏）
motor 报出的被拒斜面实测坡度 >= 49°：拒绝的是这块 50° 板，不是别的输入

v2：50° 板没被登记成斜面（D5：AddRamp 的 45° 门不动），球爬的是它 0.60 m 高的世界 AABB 盒面，所以「50° 在爬升带」只是旁证。阈值不写常数：驱动算 1.02·H_cap + cap_margin，H_cap = ContactTuning.KHeight · D = 1.5·D（裸球无线尖，2026-11-16 owner 拍板 k_h=1.5）。四档：D0.30 到 cap 后滑回（+0.3068 是 pass8 在 k_h=1.0 时的实测），D0.60 爬完 0.60 板顶（+0.5999），D1.10 也爬完（+0.6000），D2.20 直接滚过去。上界成立；下界（真的爬了 ≥0.5·H_cap）仍由 W2 建好后补。
v2：这块板不再是墙，球越过板面继续走（pass8 −0.0817 / −0.9843 / −2.1042 / −2.9522）。blocked_gap_m <= 0 表示球心至少推进到板面

driver.kind_whitelist_note: the driver re-sends this after every Reapply because the arena's own whitelist is the cell's prop kinds only; a feeder candidate must pass the same absorb gate as a prop. Extend it with the prop kinds when C18/C19 land
blocked_notes: readout=trace checks are read from the console by a human, so the driver reports them as BLOCKED_UNTIL_manual and counts them as skipped, never as failures
readout=counter checks need the P4 step-cost counters and report BLOCKED_UNTIL_P4

gate=P2 checks are measured when a PickupFieldHost is wired with prop obstacles enabled (its SetSupportProps is the only path for prop tops; a disabled host clears both sets). P3 is in the tree since d31dc9b, so a gate=P3 check is MEASURED: the driver no longer reports BLOCKED_UNTIL_P3

a metric the driver cannot read now says WHY: reason=unknownMetric means the criterion names a metric with no driver branch (a data typo), while reason=noDeckSample/noLiftSample/noSetter/sizeModelMissing/quantumUnavailable means the metric is real but this run cannot answer it (design 8.3.2)

a run whose setter says converged but whose ball is not within SizeAppliedToleranceM (20 mm, a constant) of the target is BLOCKED_UNTIL_size with reason=sizeNotApplied, not a physics result (defect 1 of the 2026-11-15 matrix)

the driver and the setter stamp their U# program revision in Start ([ptf] build=... / [ptf] setter build=...); a log without those lines, or with error=unknownMetric / BLOCKED_UNTIL_P3, is a stale program and its matrix must not be read (design 8.3.3)

size stage contract: Switch issues the ONE SetDiameterM(D) of the run; TickSize only observes and then checks the ball really is within SizeAppliedToleranceM (20 mm) of the target, otherwise reason=sizeNotApplied. Python guard: no SetDiameterM/BeginRequest in TickSize

applicability: a check whose applies_d bit is 0 at a diameter is reported SKIPPED_NOT_APPLICABLE (counted as skipped, listed in a notApplicable line, never a pass) - this is for scenes that cannot produce the scenario, not for retiring a red criterion (design 4.1.4)
ramp_entry_progress_m latches the run MAX of (progress - rampFootM); the ramp_entered limit is derived per run as the motor's stepLimit (0.25*D) and logged as a 'derived ... min_progress=' line

ball_size.quantum_formula: D / (3 * (baselineVolumeUnits + confirmed)); d(D^3)/dV = D^3 / (baselineVolumeUnits + confirmed). The pricing constant (cubicMetersPerVolumeUnit) and the semantic/core ratio cancel, so the baseline is the only motor number the model needs
ball_size.size_model_input: sizeModelBaselineVolumeUnits, written by the criteria importer from the SCENE motor's serialized baselineVolumeUnits; the motor exposes no getter for it (nor for cubicMetersPerVolumeUnit / semanticDiameterPerCoreDiameter / maxCoreRadiusWorldM)
ball_size.why_analytic: the slope is analytic: D^3 is linear in the total volume (steps C+D: mm^3), so one feed lands the ball on the preset diameter and size_accuracy is abs(diameter_error_m) <= 0.001 for every tier (2026-11-16: the old integer-unit quantum metric is retired with the unit it measured)
ball_size.feed_primitive: motor.SubmitCandidate(true, feederKind, feederBounds, ballCenter, units, feederId, gen)
ball_size.why_no_runtime_change: the diameter is a pure function of the confirmed volume, and SubmitCandidate already exists as the host-side seam, so the setter feeds integer volume units and reads the diameter back. Integer because the absorb gate refuses a fractional value (TryAbsorbValueToLedgerGain)
ball_size.side_effects: absorb count, ledger volume and the absorb volume limit all grow; every check that reads them uses a baseline delta (PHYSICS_TEST_FIELD 8.3)
ball_size.request_restart: SetDiameterM is the ONLY request entry point and it is called exactly once per run, from the driver's Switch after TryResetForNewRound (which re-prices the ball to the baseline). Every call clears converged/absorbCount/nextFeedTime and re-feeds, so a second cell in the same tier is resized too (pass-1 defect: only the first cell per tier grew) and a poll loop never clears the flag it is waiting for (pass-2 regression: TickSize called SetDiameterM every frame, converged flipped false each frame and the size stage timed out). The poll is read-only: IsConverged/HasFailed/GetQuantumM/GetLastErrorM. There is no BeginRequest any more
ball_size.live_quantum: GetQuantumM()/GetCubedSlope() call ReadSizeModel() on every read; there is no cached quantum. A cached value from the previous Feed is what printed +41.2674/+371.6536/+3523.0036 for the cells that never grew

criteria_importer.rule: the JSON is the only authoring copy; nothing here is typed twice

layout: README.md（谁跑的、Unity/SDK/客户端版本、结论）
evidence.screenshot_rule: 每格每球径至少 2 张：cam_top + 该格主相机；起伏类再补 cam_chase 连拍

override_rows.why: A check may carry an optional v2 block that replaces its base row (metric, op+limit or threshold, per-diameter expect). The importer bakes it into the cell's override arrays and the driver judges the override instead of the base row. Rows without a block are judged as written.

override_keys.expect: 4 项 pass/fail/n/a，替换基础行的 expect（按 diameters[] 顺序）
override_keys.metric: 替换读取的指标名；必须是驱动 TryReadMetric 能回答的名字
override_keys.op: 替换比较符；op 一定连带 limit（数据里两者必须同时出现），或配 threshold
override_keys.limit: 替换 op 的常数限
override_keys.threshold: 符号阈值，驱动在运行期按电机常数算，此时不写 limit。目前只有一个值：climb_cap_bound = 1.02·H_cap + ContactTuning.ClimbCapMarginM，H_cap = ContactTuning.KHeight · D
override_keys.not_applicable: true = 四档全 n/a（等价于 expect 全 n/a），驱动报 SKIPPED_N_A 并计入 skipped
override_keys.note: 人读的说明，不参与编码；

driver_rules: an override row is fully explicit: the deck_gap and ramp_entry stepLimit derivations apply only to base rows
a base row and its override carry their own expect mask, metric, op and limit; they never mix
op "record" is a diagnostic: the value is logged with verdict=DIAGNOSTIC and counts as neither pass nor unexpected nor skipped
a cell with run_at_d[i] = false is not driven at that diameter (logged as SKIPPED_NOT_RUN)
